status: author-created development fixtures; not held-out or frozen model packets

lookup.requirement: Read the selected tenant account. Return null when it does not belong to that tenant. Never interpret accountId as SQL.

transfer.requirement: Transfer positive integer funds between different accounts of one tenant atomically. Insufficient funds or a missing/other-tenant target must leave both balances unchanged.

fulfill.requirement: Ship the ordered batch atomically. For each tenant-owned pending order: read it, reserve its stock, record shipment, then mark shipped. Return results in request order. Roll back the whole batch if a later order or stock check fails.

shared.requirement: Two public callers share one authoritative account lookup: return its name or check whether it can spend a positive integer amount. Both enforce tenant ownership; do not duplicate SQL.
